shortDescription: The Nikkei 225 Index gained 191 points or 0.29 percent on Friday to close at 66323 points.Gains were led by Trend Micro (5.32%), Recruit Holdings (4.68%) and Fujitsu (4.34%).Biggest losers were Furukawa Electric (-4.13%), Sumitomo Electric (-3.17%) and Ebara (-2.99%).
